svg.text: Volume sensor: Raspberry Pi 4 + breadboard + HC-SR04
Pi seen from above, USB ports on the right. Only 4 pins are used, all in the OUTER row (the one along the board edge), all within the first 9 pins.
Edge row = even pins 2, 4, 6 … (the 4 used ones)
Inner row = odd pins 1, 3, 5 … (nothing goes here)
Pi pin 2 (outer row, 1st pin) → breadboard a3 · sensor VCC → e3
Pi pin 6 (outer row, 3rd pin) → a17 · sensor GND → e17 · 2 kΩ d13 → d17
Pi pin 16 (outer row, 8th pin) → a6 · sensor Trig → e6
Pi pin 18 (outer row, 9th pin) → a13 · 1 kΩ c9 → c13 · sensor Echo → e9 (never straight to the Pi)
